rationale.conceptual: Standard DFT+NEB method, but requires domain knowledge of crystal structure, defect formation (octahedral/tetrahedral sites, interstitial types), and careful selection of multiple migration paths. The paper's specific paths and site types add non-trivial implementation complexity.
rationale.execution: Multi-stage pipeline: build supercell, relax pristine and four defect supercells, run eight distinct NEB calculations, compute activation energies. Each stage requires DFT infrastructure (GPAW, ASE) with fragile dependencies and significant compute time. Orchestrating many NEB jobs with correct initial/final states is non-trivial.

Resources: 144-atom supercell, CPU-only, modest memory, negligible data.
